quotes: A core limitation of CroPA lies in its random noise initialization strategy
contradictions.description: Algorithm 1 initializes the adversarial image to the unchanged original image, meaning zero initial perturbation. Section 5.1 instead describes CroPA as starting with random noise and makes that initialization a central motivation for the proposed enhancement.

quotes: This loss encourages the perturbed image’s value vectors to closely align with the target text’s representation.
contradictions.description: Equation 11 defines a cosine-distance loss, whose minimization encourages alignment. But Equation 12 subtracts that distance from the objective minimized for the image perturbation, thereby encouraging greater distance rather than the claimed alignment.

quotes: In our experiments, we present all cross-prompt and cross-model transferability results under the untargeted attack setting.
Table 1: Targeted ASRs tested on Flamingo with different target texts, across a variety of Vision-Language tasks.
contradictions.description: The blanket statement that all cross-prompt results use untargeted attacks conflicts with the explicitly targeted cross-prompt evaluation in Table 1 and several subsequent tables.

quotes: the integration of our method (CroPA+Init) consistently outperforms both CroPA and Multi-P across all metrics
contradictions.description: CroPA+Init does not outperform CroPA across all metrics: for “unknown,” both VQA scores decrease. Table 3 also contains classification and VQA-specific regressions for other targets.

quotes: We believe CutMix outperforms SCMix in promoting adversarial transferability because its region-based mixing maintains distinct, non-overlapping spatial areas.
contradictions.description: The results discussion says CutMix outperforms SCMix, but Table 5 shows substantially higher overall ASR for SCMix. SCMix also performs better on two tasks, ties on classification, and loses only narrowly on VQA-specific.

The Multi-P overall ASR is inconsistent with its task scores and the equal-task averaging used throughout the tables, including the adjacent CroPA row. Its four task scores average to 0.7085, not 0.7585.

quotes: an 12.5% increase from CroPA’s base method
an 13.5% improvement over the base CroPA method as shown in 6.5.3
contradictions.description: The same overall ASR improvement is reported as both 12.5% and 13.5%. The table supports an increase of 12.52 percentage points, not 13.5.
